examples: `new Cell` stores two values and calls nothing; `Cell::of` makes the same cell, and its examples show every way a cell is used.
perf: `new Cell` stores two values and calls nothing; `Cell::of` builds one on every call, so its figure includes this one.
hostile: `new Cell` stores two typed read-only values and calls nothing, so a wrong style does not compile; a hostile value is checked when the row is written, and the attack of `Cell::of` sends one.
